question: What decision currently governs python encoding warning policy? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-597 is the currently active decision governing Python's encoding warning policy, implementing an optional EncodingWarning.
The authority evidence for PEP-597 is recorded at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/b2120d116aa696f409b4d8333c4020ab8f93c9c7/peps/pep-0597.rst.
